objective: Help parents and caregivers of children ages 3–8 explore how stories can introduce the idea that trust may take time, while encouraging qualified visitors to view the available editions on Amazon.
audience: Parents and caregivers of children ages 3–8 who value warm animal stories and want age-appropriate ways to discuss kindness, patience, trust, and belonging.
campaign_theme: Trust can grow through patience, kindness, and time.
rationale: The client profile has approved story facts, audiences, brand voice, calls to action, purchase and website links, an author story, and a sourced review. The approved metadata-clean front-cover derivative jordan-and-the-fosters-front-cover-marketing-1600h is available for official website and social recommendations under its recorded permissions.
recommended_channels: Social channels linked from the official website

content_assignments.instructions: Create a warm official website feature titled “When Trust Takes Time” that differs meaningfully from the August 3 feature. Focus on how Jordan's cautious journey can help parents and caregivers discuss patience and slowly developing trust with children ages 3–8. State exactly once that Jordan and the Fosters is available in paperback, hardcover, and digital editions. End with exactly one approved CTA and exactly one canonical Amazon URL (https://www.amazon.com/gp/aw/d/B0D5BT1XDZ). The optional approved quotation is “Joe Dinicola tells a tale that would likely inspire a child and parent to explore ways to express care for others.” — Constance Stadler, Readers’ Favorite. If used, reproduce the quotation and attribution exactly once. Recommend approved asset jordan-and-the-fosters-front-cover-marketing-1600h. Do not modify, transform, embed, upload, publish, or externally transmit the image.

asset_recommendations.diagnostic: path, type, dimensions, file size, and SHA-256 checksum verified

content_assignments.channel: Social channels linked from the official website
content_assignments.instructions: Create one social-awareness post of 100–140 words for parents and caregivers of children ages 3–8. Focus on how stories can help children understand that a cautious animal may need patience before trust develops. Make the structure and wording meaningfully different from the August 3 social post. Do not mention edition formats or use the review quotation. End with exactly one approved CTA and exactly one canonical Amazon URL (https://www.amazon.com/gp/aw/d/B0D5BT1XDZ). Do not invent a platform, hashtag, or character limit. Recommend approved asset jordan-and-the-fosters-front-cover-marketing-1600h.
